application.route: Train, Judgement Puzzles notes board (desktop 1366, phone 390)

component: Toolbar density: nine equal icon buttons replaced by four direct controls and one grouped options menu

screenshots.note: Phase 3: the options menu open at 390 from a compact icon trigger, fully inside the viewport.

explanation:
CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (training-notes.md N6 to N9). Observed: nine same weight icon buttons in one row, the ninth clipped by the panel edge, most used rarely, one (annotation symbols) opening a hidden 19 symbol grid. Rule applied: frequency decides visibility. At most about four direct controls per small tool; the rest live in one grouped menu button with a visible word on the trigger (Options, accessible name Notes board options), groups labelled (Position, Board, Annotate move), full APG menu button pattern (open with Enter, Space or ArrowDown; arrows, Home, End wrap; Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes; click outside closes), items that cannot act are disabled with a reason, 36px targets with a precise pointer and 40px under a coarse pointer. Every function was preserved. P10 (minimalism over prevalence) covers the direction but gives no number and no grouping or menu button rule. Related: the workspace rail options menu (see the rail issue) uses the same pattern, and a shared menu button preset would serve both.

PHASE 3 UPDATE (2026-10-29, claude-agent, draft text only), compact contextual options menu (see notes.md B1 to B5). The draft rule above said 'one grouped menu button with a visible word on the trigger'. Phase 3 amends that: the trigger is one compact icon button (an ellipsis, the conventional sign for more actions; a gear suggests settings but the menu holds actions) with aria-label and title 'Board options', 36px and 40px under pointer coarse, transparent until hovered, instead of a large labelled button as heavy as the navigation. A visible word is optional when the icon is conventional and named; the menu content, groups, keyboard pattern and disabled with a reason are unchanged. NEW REQUIREMENT FOUND BY A BROWSER CHECK: the menu must not be clipped. A right aligned menu opened from a trigger at the left edge sat at left -4px at 1440. Rule: position the floating menu from the trigger and clamp it inside the viewport with a margin (8px), and verify at the narrowest and widest layouts (screenshot after-notes-menu-390.png shows it fully visible at 390). Keyboard and touch: Enter, Space and ArrowDown open, ArrowUp opens on the last item, Home and End, Escape returns focus to the trigger, Tab and an outside press close. Open point: a transparent trigger is close to the ghost button question in FB-0018 (undecided); it is visible at rest as an icon and full strength on touch.

classification.rationale: P10 states the direction (fewer visible controls) but not a threshold or the grouped menu button pattern. Gap or ambiguity at the margin; the count of 4 is a judgement the owner must set. Owner confirmation needed.
